import heapq

class MCFGraph:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.pos = []
        self.to = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.rev = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.cap = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.cost = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add_edge(self, fr, to, cap, cost):
        m = len(self.pos)
        self.pos.append((fr, len(self.to[fr])))
        self.to[fr].append(to)
        self.rev[fr].append(len(self.to[to]))
        self.cap[fr].append(cap)
        self.cost[fr].append(cost)
        self.to[to].append(fr)
        self.rev[to].append(len(self.to[fr]) - 1)
        self.cap[to].append(0)
        self.cost[to].append(-cost)
        return m

    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, fr, to, cap, flow, cost):
            self.fr = fr
            self.to = to
            self.cap = cap
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

    def get_edge(self, i):
        fr, idx = self.pos[i]
        to = self.to[fr][idx]
        rev_idx = self.rev[fr][idx]
        cap = self.cap[fr][idx]
        rev_cap = self.cap[to][rev_idx]
        cost = self.cost[fr][idx]
        return self.Edge(fr, to, cap + rev_cap, rev_cap, cost)

    def edges(self):
        res = []
        for i in range(len(self.pos)):
            fr, idx = self.pos[i]
            to = self.to[fr][idx]
            rev_idx = self.rev[fr][idx]
            cap = self.cap[fr][idx]
            rev_cap = self.cap[to][rev_idx]
            cost = self.cost[fr][idx]
            res.append(self.Edge(fr, to, cap + rev_cap, rev_cap, cost))
        return res

    def _dual_ref(self, s, t):
        INF = 10**18
        dist = [INF] * self.n
        pv = [-1] * self.n
        pe = [-1] * self.n
        vis = [False] * self.n
        dist[s] = 0
        pq = [(0, s)]
        while pq:
            d, v = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if vis[v]:
                continue
            vis[v] = True
            if v == t:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.to[v])):
                if vis[self.to[v][i]] or self.cap[v][i] == 0:
                    continue
                cost = self.cost[v][i] - self.dual[self.to[v][i]] + self.dual[v]
                nd = d + cost
                if dist[self.to[v][i]] > nd:
                    dist[self.to[v][i]] = nd
                    pv[self.to[v][i]] = v
                    pe[self.to[v][i]] = i
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, self.to[v][i]))
        if not vis[t]:
            return False
        for v in range(self.n):
            if vis[v]:
                self.dual[v] -= dist[t] - dist[v]
        self.pv = pv
        self.pe = pe
        return True

    def slope(self, s, t, flow_limit=10**18):
        self.dual = [0] * self.n
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        prev_cost = -1
        result = [(flow, cost)]
        while flow < flow_limit:
            if not self._dual_ref(s, t):
                break
            c = flow_limit - flow
            v = t
            while v != s:
                c = min(c, self.cap[self.pv[v]][self.pe[v]])
                v = self.pv[v]
            v = t
            while v != s:
                idx = self.pe[v]
                self.cap[self.pv[v]][idx] -= c
                rev_idx = self.rev[self.pv[v]][idx]
                self.cap[v][rev_idx] += c
                v = self.pv[v]
            d = -self.dual[s]
            flow += c
            cost += c * d
            if prev_cost == d:
                result.pop()
            result.append((flow, cost))
            prev_cost = d
        return result

    def flow(self, s, t, flow_limit=10**18):
        return self.slope(s, t, flow_limit)[-1]

<translated_code>
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class MCFGraph {
        int n;
        ArrayList<int[]> pos; // each int[] = {fr, idx}
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> to;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> rev;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> cap;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> cost;
        long[] dual;
        int[] pv;
        int[] pe;

        MCFGraph(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            pos = new ArrayList<>();
            to = new ArrayList<>(n);
            rev = new ArrayList<>(n);
            cap = new ArrayList<>(n);
            cost = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                to.add(new ArrayList<>());
                rev.add(new ArrayList<>());
                cap.add(new ArrayList<>());
                cost.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        int addEdge(int fr, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            int m = pos.size();
            pos.add(new int[]{fr, this.to.get(fr).size()});
            this.to.get(fr).add(to);
            this.rev.get(fr).add(this.to.get(to).size()); // index of reverse edge in to's list (before adding reverse)
            this.cap.get(fr).add(cap);
            this.cost.get(fr).add(cost);
            // reverse edge
            this.to.get(to).add(fr);
            this.rev.get(to).add(this.to.get(fr).size() - 1); // index of forward edge in fr's list
            this.cap.get(to).add(0);
            this.cost.get(to).add(-cost);
            return m;
        }

        static class Edge {
            int fr, to, cap, flow, cost;
            Edge(int fr, int to, int cap, int flow, int cost) {
                this.fr = fr;
                this.to = to;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        Edge getEdge(int i) {
            int[] p = pos.get(i);
            int fr = p[0];
            int idx = p[1];
            int to = this.to.get(fr).get(idx);
            int revIdx = this.rev.get(fr).get(idx);
            int cap = this.cap.get(fr).get(idx);
            int revCap = this.cap.get(to).get(revIdx);
            int cost = this.cost.get(fr).get(idx);
            return new Edge(fr, to, cap + revCap, revCap, cost);
        }

        ArrayList<Edge> edges() {
            ArrayList<Edge> res = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < pos.size(); i++) {
                int[] p = pos.get(i);
                int fr = p[0];
                int idx = p[1];
                int to = this.to.get(fr).get(idx);
                int revIdx = this.rev.get(fr).get(idx);
                int cap = this.cap.get(fr).get(idx);
                int revCap = this.cap.get(to).get(revIdx);
                int cost = this.cost.get(fr).get(idx);
                res.add(new Edge(fr, to, cap + revCap, revCap, cost));
            }
            return res;
        }

        boolean _dualRef(int s, int t) {
            long INF = 1_000_000_000_000_000_000L;
            long[] dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            int[] pv = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(pv, -1);
            int[] pe = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(pe, -1);
            boolean[] vis = new boolean[n];
            dist[s] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = pq.poll();
                long d = cur[0];
                int v = (int) cur[1];
                if (vis[v]) continue;
                vis[v] = true;
                if (v == t) break;
                ArrayList<Integer> toV = to.get(v);
                ArrayList<Integer> capV = cap.get(v);
                ArrayList<Integer> costV = cost.get(v);
                for (int i = 0; i < toV.size(); i++) {
                    int u = toV.get(i);
                    if (vis[u] || capV.get(i) == 0) continue;
                    long cost = (long) costV.get(i) - dual[u] + dual[v];
                    long nd = d + cost;
                    if (dist[u] > nd) {
                        dist[u] = nd;
                        pv[u] = v;
                        pe[u] = i;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{nd, u});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!vis[t]) return false;
            for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                if (vis[v]) {
                    dual[v] -= dist[t] - dist[v];
                }
            }
            this.pv = pv;
            this.pe = pe;
            return true;
        }

        ArrayList<long[]> slope(int s, int t, long flowLimit) {
            dual = new long[n];
            long flow = 0;
            long cost = 0;
            long prevCost = -1;
            ArrayList<long[]> result = new ArrayList<>();
            result.add(new long[]{flow, cost});
            while (flow < flowLimit) {
                if (!_dualRef(s, t)) break;
                long c = flowLimit - flow;
                int v = t;
                while (v != s) {
                    c = Math.min(c, cap.get(pv[v]).get(pe[v]));
                    v = pv[v];
                }
                v = t;
                while (v != s) {
                    int idx = pe[v];
                    int pvV = pv[v];
                    ArrayList<Integer> capPv = cap.get(pvV);
                    capPv.set(idx, capPv.get(idx) - (int) c);
                    int revIdx = rev.get(pvV).get(idx);
                    ArrayList<Integer> capV = cap.get(v);
                    capV.set(revIdx, capV.get(revIdx) + (int) c);
                    v = pvV;
                }
                long d = -dual[s];
                flow += c;
                cost += c * d;
                if (prevCost == d) {
                    result.remove(result.size() - 1);
                }
                result.add(new long[]{flow, cost});
                prevCost = d;
            }
            return result;
        }

        long[] flow(int s, int t) {
            return flow(s, t, 1_000_000_000_000_000_000L);
        }

        long[] flow(int s, int t, long flowLimit) {
            ArrayList<long[]> res = slope(s, t, flowLimit);
            return res.get(res.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt(); // not used
        int a1 = sc.nextInt();
        int a2 = sc.nextInt();
        int a3 = sc.nextInt();
        int b1 = sc.nextInt();
        int b2 = sc.nextInt();
        int b3 = sc.nextInt();

        MCFGraph g = new MCFGraph(8);
        g.addEdge(0, 1, a1, 0);
        g.addEdge(0, 2, a2, 0);
        g.addEdge(0, 3, a3, 0);
        g.addEdge(4, 7, b1, 0);
        g.addEdge(5, 7, b2, 0);
        g.addEdge(6, 7, b3, 0);
        int INF_CAP = 1_000_000_000;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
                int cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
                g.addEdge(i, j, INF_CAP, cost);
            }
        }

        long[] flowRes = g.flow(0, 7);
        long ans1 = flowRes[1];
        long ans2 = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
        System.out.println(ans1 + " " + ans2);
    }
}
